connector.name: MCP by quantustik
connector.registryDescription: Live S&P 500 quantum-model signals, forecasts and trade plans. Educational, not financial advice.
connector.summary: Hosted at quantustik.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the quantustik account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. "Bearer <API_KEY>" raises quota above the anonymous per-IP hourly cap. Get a free key at https://quantustik.com/developers.

env.name: QUANTUSTIK_API_KEY
env.description: Optional. Sent as "Authorization: Bearer <key>" to raise quota above the anonymous per-IP hourly cap. Get a free key at https://quantustik.com/developers.
